This figure indicated the strongest improvement in manufacturing operating conditions since May 2022 and a return to expansion, as any reading above 50 signals growth. The positive data was driven by a surge in production, which rose at its steepest pace since May 2022, and an eighth consecutive monthly increase in new orders. The upbeat reading suggested the private sector was gaining traction, which led to a strengthening of the US Dollar, with the US Dollar Index (DXY) advancing to weekly highs following the preliminary announcement.
